{{Quote|&hellip;The reaction has been unanimously ''negative''&mdash;more neutral planets in the Valahari sector are threatening to side with the Separatists.|[[Ki-Adi-Mundi/Legends|Ki-Adi-Mundi]]|<ref name="TCW10" />}}
The '''Valahari sector''',<ref name="TCW10" /> also known as the '''Valahari Provinces''',<ref name="TEGtW">{{SW|url=news/star-wars-the-essential-guide-to-warfare-authors-cut-part-10-the-rise-of-the-empire|series=Star Wars: The Essential Guide to Warfare Author's Cut|text=Part 10: The Rise of the Empire}}</ref> was a [[Sector/Legends|subsector]] of the [[D'Astan sector/Legends|D'Astan sector]], in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]].<ref name="EAOC" /> It contained the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Valahari/Legends|Valahari]].<ref name="TCW10" />

==History==
{{Quote|The ''Jedi'' started this war, and they will ''always'' be responsible for father's murder.''"<br />"''I know that fuels your anger. But you have freed our people and all the worlds of the Provinces. Please, come home.''"<br />"''This fight is bigger than Valahari or the Provinces. The whole galaxy will remember who came to their aid. I cannot&mdash;''will'' not&mdash;walk away now.|[[Tofen Vane/Legends|Tofen Vane]] and [[Elodore Vane]]|<ref name="TCW12">[[The Clone Wars 12|''The Clone Wars'' 12]]</ref>}}
The sector was the site of intense fighting during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].<ref name="TCW10" /><ref name="TCW11" /><ref name="TCW12" />

[[Turr Phennir/Legends|Turr Phennir]] was [[Reproduction/Legends|born]] in the Valahari Provinces.<ref name="TEGtW" />
{{Sec-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
[[Jason Fry]], co-author of the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', indicated during the development of the [[Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion|''The Essential Atlas'' Online Companion]] that the Samarine and Valahari subsectors of the D'Astan sector present in the Online Companion were meant to be the [[Samarine Province|Samarine]] and Valahari Provinces.<ref name="Email">{{EmailCite|email=File:EAOC discussion 2023 3.jpg|creator=Jason Fry|date=2023-04-12}}</ref>
